title: 第23章 佛爷的金钟专治各种不服第24章 在小爷面前玩鬼班门弄斧
content_zh:
悟德把金钟往前一扔。
金钟在半空中急速膨胀，从巴掌大变成水缸大，一口罩住了古曼童。
“当——！”
金钟落地，把古曼童死死扣在里面。
“嗷——！”
金钟内部传来一声凄厉的婴儿啼哭，震得金钟表面的梵文都在发光。
古曼童在里面疯了，拼命撞击钟壁。
“砰！砰！砰！”
金钟被撞得左右晃动，地板上的瓷砖都被震裂了几块。
悟德站在金钟旁边，双手合十。
“大威天龙！”
一掌拍在钟身上。
“当——！”
钟声和佛号叠加在一起，金色涟漪从钟壁渗透进去。
里面的古曼童发出一声惨叫，撞击的力度弱了几分。
但它没放弃。
“嗷嗷嗷——！”
古曼童怨气暴涨，在金钟内部猛冲猛撞，婴儿啼哭声刺耳得令人头皮发麻。
那声音不是正常婴儿的哭声，更接近于几十把锯子同时在铁板上拉。
陈邪坐在窗台上，掏了颗瓜子磕着，一副看戏的架势。

“嚯，这小东西劲还挺大。”
悟德没搭理他。
他撸起阿玛尼西装的袖子，露出手腕上一串沉香佛珠。
“世尊如来！”
又一掌拍上去。
“当！”
“药师琉璃！”
“当！”
“地藏王菩萨！”
“当当当！”
一声比一声重，一掌比一掌狠。
每拍一下，金钟里的古曼童就惨叫一声，身上的黑气就淡一层。
但这玩意儿是真顽强。
被佛光灼烧着，怨气一层层剥落，它还是在撞。
撞了一下又一下。
撞得金钟嗡嗡响。
content_en:
Wu De threw the golden bell forward.
The golden bell expanded rapidly in mid-air, from the size of a palm to the size of a water tank, and covered Gumantong with its mask.
"Dang-!"
The golden bell fell to the ground and held Gumantong tightly inside.
"Ouch——!"
A shrill cry of a baby came from inside the golden clock, causing the Sanskrit characters on the surface of the golden clock to glow.
Gumantong went crazy inside and hit the wall of the bell desperately.
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
The golden bell was shaken from side to side by the impact, and several tiles on the floor were shattered.
Wu De stood beside the golden bell, clasping his hands.
"The mighty Tianlong!"
A palm slapped Zhong.
"Dang-!"
The sound of the bell and the Buddha's name are superimposed, and golden ripples penetrate from the bell wall.
The Gumantong inside let out a scream, and the impact was a little weaker.
But it didn't give up.
"Ouch-ouch—!"
Gumantong's resentment surged, and he rushed and bumped inside the golden bell. The baby's cry was so harsh that it made people feel numb.
The sound was not the cry of a normal baby, but closer to the sound of dozens of saws pulling on an iron plate at the same time.
Chen Xie sat on the window sill, took out a melon seed and cracked it, as if watching a show.
"Oh, this little thing is quite powerful."
Wude ignored him.
He rolled up the sleeves of his Armani suit, revealing a string of agarwood beads on his wrist.
"World Honored One Tathagata!"
Another slap came up.
"Dang!"
"Yakushi Liuli!"
"Dang!"
"Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva!"
"Dang Dang Dang!"
Each sound was heavier than the other, and each slap was more severe than the last.
With every tap, the Gumantong in the golden bell screamed, and the black energy on his body became lighter.
But this thing is really tough.
Burned by the Buddha's light, the resentment peeled off layer by layer, but it was still bumping.
Bumped again and again.
The golden bell buzzed.
